key_highlights: RBA issues blunt warning ahead of next rate decision; IMF urges spending cuts as another hike looms, signalling sustained monetary tightening
ASX closed volatile week with modest gains as oil prices and bond yields eased; big four banks (CBA, ANZ, NAB, WBC) advanced
Iron ore prices under pressure ('roaches seethe'), weighing on BHP, RIO, FMG; LNG pricing distorted as Japan diverts gas from East Coast
2027 recession odds rising; petrol price shock and housing unaffordability intensify consumer squeeze
Anthropic secures $31bn datacentre deal in western Queensland, boosting Australian tech/infrastructure narrative
Gold exploration positives: Forrestania four WA prefeasibility studies; Aurum high-grade gold outside 3.22Moz Côte d'Ivoire resource
Qantas ground staff strike threat over Joyce-era bargaining; Coles maintains elevated milk prices despite axing farmer support
Bendigo Bank (BEN.AX) cuts hit Adelaide workforce; ASX small-cap runners: Latrobe, CurveBeam, Arrow, Sultan

sectors.trend: Iron ore weakness persists; gold exploration names show relative strength. LNG pricing distorted by Japan gas diversion.
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX face margin pressure on iron ore. Gold juniors (Forrestania, Aurum) attract speculative flows. Woodside (WDS.AX) and Santos (STO.AX) exposed to LNG pricing volatility.

sectors.trend: Big four banks advanced on easing yields; Bendigo Bank cuts signal sector consolidation. RBA warning and IMF pressure create rate-hike overhang.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, ANZ.AX, NAB.AX, WBC.AX benefit from wider NIMs if rates rise further, but credit risk rises with recession odds. BEN.AX under structural pressure.

sectors.trend: Petrol price shock hits consumers; Middle East oil shock risk elevated; Victoria retreats from renewable transmission; coal policy uncertainty.
sectors.implications: SAP.AX, WDS.AX, STO.AX face mixed signals. Renewables (ARE.AX, LNC.AX) hit by Victoria transmission reversal. Coal (BRL.AX, WES.AX) policy risk.

sectors.trend: Housing unaffordability at extreme; Coles maintains milk price premium; Qantas strike risk; working holiday visa limits hit regional businesses.
sectors.implications: WES.AX, CBA.AX (mortgage demand), QAN.AX (strike risk), and regional retail face headwinds. Consumer discretionary under pressure.

sectors.trend: Anthropic $31bn QLD datacentre deal signals major Australian tech infrastructure buildout. ASX small-cap tech runners active.
sectors.implications: CurveBeam (CRB.AX) and small-cap tech gain momentum. Datacentre buildout benefits construction and power utilities long-term.

sectors.trend: Novo Nordisk obesity strategy rethink; Gilead HIV expansion. Limited direct ASX impact but CSL (CSL.AX) benefits from global pharma M&A activity.
sectors.implications: CSL.AX, SSW.AX, OSH.AX relatively insulated; global pharma consolidation supports Australian biotech sentiment.

key_themes: Monetary tightening cycle: RBA warning + IMF spending-cut pressure + potential rate hike
Commodity headwinds: iron ore softness, LNG pricing distortion, petrol shock
Consumer squeeze: housing unaffordability, food pricing, strike risk
Recession risk rising for 2027; global 'four horsemen' narrative
Gold exploration renaissance in WA and West Africa
Geopolitical risk: Middle East oil shock, Russian hybrid attacks, US-China auto tensions

risk_assessment.mitigation: Overweight short-duration bonds; favour banks with strong NIMs; reduce rate-sensitive REIT exposure.
Reduce BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX weightings; rotate into gold and defensive staples.
Increase cash allocation; favour dividend-paying defensives (WES.AX, CBA.AX); avoid high-beta consumer discretionary.
Avoid QAN.AX ahead of strike vote; monitor travel and logistics sector spillover.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Middle East oil shock / geopolitical escalation
risk_assessment.mitigation: Maintain energy hedges; monitor Brent crude; keep portfolio diversified across regions.
Monitor bank NPL trends; reduce REIT exposure; watch tenant relief policy impact on property sector.

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight big four banks on rate-hike cycle
opportunities.rationale: Wider NIMs from sustained tightening; ASX banks advanced on easing yields, confirming rate sensitivity.
Forrestania four WA prefeasibility studies and Aurum Côte d'Ivoire discovery signal sector re-rating; gold hedges recession risk.
Anthropic $31bn QLD deal anchors multi-year capex cycle; benefits construction, power, and small-cap tech.

defensive_moves.rationale: Iron ore weakness and LNG pricing distortion pressure margins; recession risk amplifies commodity downside.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim REIT and rate-sensitive consumer exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: RBA tightening + housing unaffordability + petrol shock compress consumer spending and property valuations.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Avoid Qantas ahead of strike vote
defensive_moves.rationale: Ground staff strike over Joyce-era agreements creates operational and earnings uncertainty.

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to remain volatile and range-bound. RBA rate decision and IMF pressure create a hawkish overhang. Banks provide relative strength; materials and energy lag. Petrol shock and consumer squeeze cap upside. Expect ^AORD to trade in a tight band with sector rotation into defensives.
market_outlook.long_term: 2027 recession odds rising and global 'four horsemen' narrative suggest a cautious 6–12 month outlook. However, Anthropic datacentre investment, gold exploration pipeline, and potential rate peak offer medium-term entry points. Structural commodity weakness (iron ore) caps mining upside. Housing and consumer stress are the key macro risks.
